decision.reason: One disclosed history and one regeneration demonstrate mixed field usefulness, not calibrated gate quality. Rejecting a whole merge for one historical fragment can discard useful obligations. Keep Jev off in primary f8764f6 comparison.
decision.existing_gap: episode_processor.py _quality judges proposed fields before ProjectMemory.commit normalizes their source excerpts and assembles prior_* fields. It cannot inspect the final carried groups.
decision.narrow_boundary: Share deterministic final-field preparation between pre-gate processing and commit. Judge prepared own excerpts with explicit field purpose, role and historical scope outside any transaction. Commit reassembles and matches assessed text/evidence while retaining freshness, source, deletion, lease and head checks. Preserve existing bounded payload/deadline and exact off-path behavior. Add no model reads.
decision.public_seam_red_test: process_project_memory with a legacy irrelevant prior_open_work fragment and a deterministic evaluator that rejects only that final field must reject without changing heads. Today that field never reaches the evaluator.
decision.evaluation_before_enforcement: Separately measure exact-copy fidelity, semantic field relevance, constraint retention, false rejections and bounded latency/cost on new cases. This report measures none of Jev accuracy, pricing, runtime latency or general consolidation quality.

limitations: Only one task and two accepted merge versions; no generalization or causal comparison.
